purpose: Stroke-opacity instance controls: independent authored/inherited solid and shader stroke opacity, nested groups/uses/aliases, source precedence, and newly stroked unpainted paths. Sixty-four cases are exact; seventeen retain explicit support gates. These development controls are separate from the original and corporate denominators.
